Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThroughputBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThroughputBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThroughputBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable unit-explicit throughput receipt for a coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating basis.

This class scales an already qualified material-balance receipt from its finite mass basis to hourly rates. It does not change the upstream chemistry or predict reactor, separation, recycle, utility, or product-yield behavior.

Version:
1.0
